Root cause of the one blocking defect, in one sentence: the new sort branch uses forgejo.DoJSONList, which deliberately maps 404 to an empty list, but on /repos/{o}/{r}/issues a 404 means 'no such repo' (a repo with zero issues returns 200 []), so passing sort silently converts a missing-repo error into an empty result. Proved with a probe against a 404 backend: without sort -> err 'get issues list err: repository does not exist'; with sort -> no error, body {"Result":null}. Same tool, same bad input, two different outcomes decided only by whether sort was supplied. Fix verified: swap DoJSONList for forgejo.DoJSON(ctx, http.MethodGet, path, nil, &issues) at issue.go:365 — one line. After the fix the sort path errors identically, and the full suite is green (16 packages ok, 0 failed, go test -race -shuffle=on -count=1 ./...). Second, non-blocking PR-only defect found: the due_date tool description at issue.go:143 tells the model 'Ignored if clear_due_date is also true' while the handler at issue.go:597 returns an error for that combination — the error is the better behavior, the description is wrong.
